response.justification: Bogdan far exceeds the 6+ year requirement with ~15 years of full-stack work and recent, directly relevant experience in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) that maps precisely to a hard-to-find requirement. He has a CS degree, deep testing/TDD credibility (authored test tooling, taught Selenium/TDD courses), and strong architecture and communication signals from talks, workshops and an open-source platform he founded. Gaps are mostly stack-specific rather than fundamental: Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Kotlin and Python are not evidenced, and frontend depth leans Ember.js more than React. Given the breadth of languages he has picked up across roles, these look like short ramp-up items, so an interview is warranted with probes on Nest.js/React depth and JS-ecosystem testing tools.
strengths: 15+ years full-stack; strong TypeScript/Node.js, AWS, MongoDB, Docker/K8s
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience matching a key requirement
Deep testing/TDD expertise plus proven mentoring and communication
concerns: No evidence of Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Playwright specifically
React exposure limited to one role; frontend history skews Ember.js/DLang
Kotlin and Python not listed; Java experience is dated (2016-2018)

key_factors.factor: Missing core stack items (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
